asset_scope: runtime-ready conversions of user-supplied original Windows game artwork
conversion: python scripts/import_original_art.py (Pillow); original artwork is converted to RGBA and enlarged with nearest-neighbor sampling; every transparent sprite frame reproduces the source DrawTile image/mask pair with image tile+0x30 and mask tile+0x60.
legacy_media_policy: The supplied original artwork is intentionally used at runtime. The legacy executable, assembly, and original audio files remain outside runtime dependencies.

assets.provenance: Original 16-color game tile sheet; converted to RGBA and enlarged 2x with nearest-neighbor sampling.
Original green circuit-board title background; converted to RGBA and enlarged 2x with nearest-neighbor sampling.
Original CHIPEND victory illustration; converted to RGBA and enlarged 2x with nearest-neighbor sampling.
Original INFOWND scoreboard panel with its steel frame, red labels, recessed readout wells, and four corner bolts; converted to RGBA and enlarged 2x with nearest-neighbor sampling.
Original scoreboard digit strip; black palette-index 0 converted to transparent RGBA, then enlarged 2x with nearest-neighbor sampling.
Original Windows game icon; converted to RGBA and enlarged 8x with nearest-neighbor sampling.
Windows multi-resolution icon generated from the supplied original game icon PNG with nearest-neighbor resizing; embedded as a Windows resource by CMake.

assets.format: PNG, RGBA, 1536x2048, 6x8 grid of 256x256 frames for tile IDs 0x40-0x6F
assets.provenance: Exact original DrawTile image/mask composition for every transparent sprite ID 0x40-0x6F; image tile ID+0x30, mask tile ID+0x60; black mask transparent; enlarged 8x using nearest-neighbor sampling.

Checked-in cleaned pixel-art variant of the supplied game's icon; used for the native window and high-resolution Windows executable resource. The exact converted original icon remains packaged as a reference.
Checked-in multi-resolution ICO built from the cleaned original-game icon artwork for the Windows executable resource.
